name: Open Nut Drop (nearby sharing) with nobody nearby
description: Opens the Nut Drop nearby-sharing screen on a device with no one else around. Instead of crashing, going blank, or spinning forever, it shows a clear 'scanning nearby' message, and the tester can back out to the wallet.
details: From the Send hub, tapping Nut Drop opens the NearPay radar; on a device with no nearby BitChat/BLE peers (the ephemeral simulator) it must degrade to the dedicated 'Scanning nearby' empty state — not a crash, blank screen, or stuck spinner — proving the BLE-dependent surface renders safely when the subsystem finds nothing. Back out to the wallet. Subsystem-unavailable axis on the Nut Drop surface (untested until now)
